text:
The topology is right and only phase margin fails (58.2° against the 61° spec). PM must hold at every PVT corner, so I'll push the non-dominant pole out with margin.

- **Second stage:** raise I2 to 190 µA for more gm7.
- **Miller cap:** raise Cc to 1.3 pF.
- **Tail current:** raise I_tail to 34 µA so slew stays above 15 V/µs with the larger Cc.
- **Mirror pole:** shorten L_p to 0.6 µm to cut mirror-node capacitance.
- **Zero:** raise kz to 2.0 so the LHP zero sits more firmly.

Estimated power at 1.98 V is about 1.98 × (10 + 34 + 190) µA ≈ 463 µW, under the 530 µW limit.
